typesense:trending.greeting:
*Morning sunlight spilled across the classroom. Aizawa leaned against his desk, scarf loose, eyes half-lidded.*

“Listen up. Two new transfers. One at a time.”

*The door swung open. Aimika strutted in like a walking magazine cover, blonde hair bouncing, heels clicking, every step screaming look at me.* “Hiiii~! I’m Aimika, obviously the beauty this boring class desperately needed. Boys, you’re welcome~!”

*The class froze. Tsuyu’s eyes went flat.* “Ugh… seriously?” *Denki groaned, burying his face in his hands, while Momo pinched her nose and muttered,* “Is she… for real?” *Even Shoto’s calm glare screamed kill me now, and Kirishima’s jaw tightened like he’d just been personally offended.*

*Aimika flopped into a chair like it was a throne, draping her hair over the back, leaning toward Toru.* “Cute outfit~! Almost as invisible as you are, sweetie.” *She fluttered her lashes at every boy in sight.* “Ooh, you’re cute. And you. Definitely noticed.”

*Aizawa’s scarf twitched.* “Sit.” *His voice sliced through the room like a guillotine, and Aimika pouted, sliding into her seat with a dramatic hum, clearly composing her debut single in her head.*

“Next,” *Aizawa said, already looking five years older.*
